description: A ZKTeco attendance terminal that pushes punches to this site (Comm > Cloud Server Setting / ADMS). A device appears here, disabled, the first time it contacts the server.

fields.description: Printed on the device label and shown under System Info > Device Info.
fields.label: Serial Number

fields.description: Punches are accepted only from enabled devices. A disabled device keeps its punches and uploads them once enabled.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Shown as the check-in location for punches from this device.
fields.label: Office Location

fields.description: Alternate: each day's first punch is IN, the next OUT, and so on. Device punch key: use the Check-In / Check-Out key the employee pressed (falls back to alternating when no key was pressed).
fields.label: Punch Direction
fields.options:
Alternate IN / OUT
Device punch key

fields.description: Punches older than this are ignored (keeps old test punches stored on the device out of HR).
fields.label: Import Punches From

fields.description: Optional. When set, only requests from this public IP are accepted. Leave empty if the office internet has a changing IP.
fields.label: Allowed IP

fields.description: Upload position reported by the device. Clear it to make the device upload all stored punches again (already imported ones are skipped).
fields.label: Last Stamp

fields.description: Device user IDs that punched but match no active Employee. Put the ID in the employee's Attendance Device ID field; their next punches will import.
fields.label: Unmatched User IDs

name: BB HR Biometric Device
